    <section id="about">
    <h2>About Me</h2>
    <p>
        I am a PhD student in Movement Science at the University of Michigan, working with Dr. David E. Conroy in the Motivation Lab. My current research focuses on affective determinants of health behavior, particularly in the context of physical activity among middle aged and older adults, as well as drinking behavior among patients with kidney stones. I also explore how emerging technologies, including generative AI, can inform personalized approaches to behavior change.
    </p>
